`_prefixes` now matches Rails; the remaining difference is the `variants:` kwarg. The controller's LookupContext is populated through `addResolver`, whose `TemplateResolver.find(name, prefix, format, extensions)` protocol has no variant parameter. The variant-aware `isExists` reads `_viewPaths`, a second, incompatible resolver protocol that the controller path never populates. Converges with 0104-twitter-app-full-stack-integration/unify-lookup-context-resolver-protocols.
